description: Na₂Fe₂F₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are four shorter (2.53 Å) and four longer (2.84 Å) Na-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.01 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-48°. There are two shorter (2.02 Å) and four longer (2.10 Å) Fe-F bond lengths. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Fe tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Fe atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Fe atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Fe tetrahedra. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Fe atoms.
